metrics.name: selected_clients

notes: Q5 and Q10 are QUALITY metrics where higher values indicate better visual quality (more splats visible)
cache_misses is the PRIMARY traffic-reduction metric per command217 N2 campaign
request_retries and request_cancellations are NOT_APPLICABLE for current fail-fast scheduler (command227 PHASE 3 BG2)
pipeline_decode and pipeline_GPU_upload are NOT_APPLICABLE for P5 3DGS streaming architecture (per CONTROL_AGENT audit 2026-10-06)
camera_changed is a critical validity signal that must be boolean true for valid runs
Resource metrics (CPU/GPU/VRAM) are aggregated across all clients at 1Hz sampling (command227 PHASE 3)
All lifecycle timing metrics (TTFB, completion) are in milliseconds and derive from Puppeteer CDP timing (command227 PHASE 3 BG1)
T1M (Time to 1M splats) may be null if 1M splats never reached (CENSORED)
Prefetch and DLS metrics are method_conditional (SPADE only)
metric_schema_version tracks evolution of metric definitions for backfill/compatibility
All SHA256 hashes bind scientific components for provenance and epoch integrity
